purpose: Validate EMIR Refit UPI format (ISO 4914, 12-character alphanumeric via ANNA Derivatives Service Bureau) and product classification consistency: asset class must be a supported EMIR class (IR/CR/EQ/CO/FX) and instrument type must be present. Terminal node of the emir-trade-report-validation chain; exports field-level validity verdict with execution_hash.
